name: Slip 'n Slide

gist.Slippery Spikeblock: One-health block. Every time it slides to a neighbouring hero it hits your hero in the same position.
gist.Slippery Snowman: When it slides, it freezes your hero in the same position for a turn (if none of yours is frozen yet).
gist.Slippery Whoolmoth: Huge creature that is free once every one of her heroes has a creature; each slide hits your hero in that lane, or a creature beside it, hard.
gist.Slippery Narw: When it slides it destroys any creature; if she picks one of her own she searches a creature.
gist.Slippery Polar: When it slides, the hero it arrives at may summon another creature for free.
gist.Slippery Pengu: When it slides it pushes another of her creatures along as well.
gist.Slippery Snobbit: When it slides she discards and redraws.
gist.Slippery Skates: Equipment: once per turn slides a creature from its hero to a neighbour.
gist.Slippery Ice: Area (Cooldin fetches it): once per turn each player may slide as many of their creatures as possible.
gist.Hel, the Bound Specter: Stands in the middle. Starts with Slippery Skates on, takes half damage while wearing them, has very little health, and is defeated if she ever ends a turn unable to re-equip them.
gist.Ingo, Investor of Evil: Gold every time a creature lands in a support zone, slides included.
gist.Cooldin, King of Coolness: Plays an Area from the deck regardless of level, ending the turn.
gist.Defending the Gate: Trap that cancels something aimed at her support zones.
gist.Deepsea Idol: Cancels a sweep on two or more creatures.
gist.Alchemic Journal: Draws or searches from her large Potion Deck (bombs, vials, revives).

plan: Everything in Sunny's deck moves. At the start of each of her turns every Slippery creature slides into a free support zone of the neighbouring hero, and each slide does something to whatever stands opposite: a hit, a freeze, a destroyed creature, a free summon. Skates and Slippery Ice add extra slides, and Ingo is paid for every one. Positions are the whole game: the damage lands on the hero in the same lane, and every slide passes through the middle hero. The creatures are small, they need free zones to slide into, and if the hero in the middle falls the two outer heroes are no longer neighbours.

looks.early: Hel in the middle already wearing Skates, a Spikeblock and a Pengu beside the outer heroes.
looks.mid: Creatures swapping sides every turn across Slippery Ice, the same one of your heroes taking the hits.
looks.late: A Whoolmoth sliding back and forth through the middle, a Snowman freezing whoever stands opposite.

opening.tell: Her first creatures are a one-health Slippery Spikeblock and a Slippery Pengu; nothing has slid yet.
opening.why: A Slippery creature only matters if it survives to her next turn to slide; killed on your turn it wasted her opening.

midgame.tell: Every slide passes through Hel in the middle, who has by far the least health and is kept alive by her Skates.
midgame.why: With the middle hero gone the outer two are not neighbours and nothing can slide; Fire Bomb on her Skates removes her damage reduction and makes her pay to stay alive.

crisis.tell: A Slippery Whoolmoth and a Snowman are lined up to slide into the lane of your Storm caster.
crisis.why: The hits always land on the hero opposite the arrival zone: deal with the one slider that threatens that lane, cure the freeze with Tea, and keep everything else on her heroes.

endgame.tell: She has two heroes left that do not stand next to each other.
endgame.why: Her creatures have nowhere to slide and do nothing standing still.

opening.board: Sunny sets a Slippery Spikeblock by Cooldin and a Pengu by Ingo; Hel, in the middle, already wears Skates.

options.text: Kill both before they ever slide

opening.board: Cooldin fetches Slippery Ice; next turn everything slides twice.
A Polar slides to Hel and she summons a second creature for free.

options.text: Firewall on the lane they head for

midgame.board: Creatures cross through Hel's zones every turn; she is the smallest hero on the table.

options.text: Fire Bomb her Skates, then burn her down

midgame.board: Spikeblocks hit the same hero of yours twice a turn.
A Narw slides and destroys her own Pengu to search out a Whoolmoth.

options.text: Kill Hel before the Whoolmoth can slide

crisis.board: The Whoolmoth and a Snowman will arrive opposite your Storm caster next turn.

options.text: Snow Cannon the Whoolmoth, hold Tea for the freeze
Sweep and hope she has no Deepsea Idol

crisis.board: Your caster is frozen by the Snowman; the Storm keeps ticking.
Defending the Gate lies face-down by the Whoolmoth.

options.text: Untargeted damage, do not aim at it

endgame.board: Hel is gone. Cooldin and Ingo stand apart and their creatures have stopped moving.

options.text: Remove an Area that no longer matters

endgame.board: She revives Hel for a single turn of slides.

options.text: Cloud in a Bottle on the lane

endgame.board: One hero each, a Spikeblock beside hers with nowhere to go.
